note: Coastal state park three miles north of Fort Bragg. Surfwood and West Pinewood take RVs in shore-pine woods beside Lake Cleone, a few hundred metres from the beach and the Haul Road trail; East Pinewood is tent-only. Tide pools at Laguna Point, seal watching, whale watching in winter and spring. --Claude
summary: MacKerricher: $45 confirmed for Dec 2026 and May 2027 (weekend the same); RVs to 35 ft in Surfwood and West Pinewood (46 units 23 ft+), East Pinewood tent-only; West Pinewood open all winter, the other two loops closed until April 2027. Coastal walk kept. Phone 707-964-9112 to add.
